routes.name: 5-Year Plan Meets Already Left
routes.universal_truth: Some couples work because one person makes life feel safe and the other makes life begin.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu turns waiting into motion: keys, booking, red-arrow changes, expressive fighting, instinct, balcony dancing.
routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv plans, grounds, repairs small details, follows her instinct, and quietly enjoys the chaos.
routes.concrete_proof: chai, notebook, phone calendar, cafe booking, checklist, bracelet fix, map screenshots, closed notebook payoff
routes.tender_thesis: Somehow, opposite tempos make perfect sense.

routes.name: Planner x Plot Twist
routes.universal_truth: The best love story is not one perfect plan; it is the person who keeps making the plan worth changing.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu becomes the playful plot twist in every plan.
routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv keeps the plan warm instead of rigid.
routes.concrete_proof: calendar, checklist, heart arrow, travel screenshots
routes.tender_thesis: He planned the future; she made it alive.

routes.name: Calm Loves Chaos
routes.universal_truth: The calm partner is not always surviving the chaos; sometimes they are quietly choosing it.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu dances, initiates, fights out loud, and pulls the day forward.
routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv watches, softens, follows, and grounds the spark.
routes.tender_thesis: He acts calm, but he loves the chaos.
